# A + Adjective + 過 + B · *A + Adjective + gwo3 + B*

**Meaning:** A is more … than B · **Level:** A2 · **Topic:** Degree and comparison

> ⚠️ **Draft — awaiting native-speaker review.** Spotted something unnatural? Please [open an issue](https://github.com/jyltsang/cantonlink-community/issues/new).

To compare, put 過 after the adjective: 佢高過我 ('he tall-past me'). The written-style 佢比我高 is understood, but 過 is the natural spoken form.

**Written Chinese:** A 比 B + Adjective — Written Chinese uses 比 before the adjective.

## Examples

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **佢高過我。** |
| Jyutping | keoi5 gou1 gwo3 ngo5. |
| Yale | kéuih gōu gwo ngóh. |
| Bopomofo | ㄎㆤㄧ⁵ ㄍㄛㄨ¹ ㄍㄨㄛ³ ㆭㄛ⁵. |
| English | He's taller than me. |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **坐地鐵快過坐巴士。** |
| Jyutping | co5 dei6 tit3 faai3 gwo3 co5 baa1 si2. |
| Yale | chóh deih tit faai gwo chóh bā sí. |
| Bopomofo | ㄘㄛ⁵ ㄉㄝㄧ⁶ ㄊㄧㆵ³ ㄈㄚㄧ³ ㄍㄨㄛ³ ㄘㄛ⁵ ㄅㄚ¹ ㄙㄧ². |
| English | The MTR is faster than the bus. |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **今日凍過尋日。** |
| Jyutping | gam1 jat6 dung3 gwo3 cam4 jat6. |
| Yale | gām yaht dung gwo chàhm yaht. |
| Bopomofo | ㄍㄜㆬ¹ ㄧㄜㆵ⁶ ㄉㄨㄥ³ ㄍㄨㄛ³ ㄘㄜㆬ⁴ ㄧㄜㆵ⁶. |
| English | Today is colder than yesterday. |

## Common mistakes

- ✗ ~~他比我高。~~ → ✓ **佢高過我。** *keoi5 gou1 gwo3 ngo5.* · *kéuih gōu gwo ngóh.*  
  他 is written; 比 sounds bookish in casual speech.
